Container.Name: claude-files-autocommit
Container.Overview:
Optional companion to claude-files. Polls the shared folder and commits and pushes whatever an agent writes there.
Unlike claude-files, this container mounts the REPOSITORY ROOT, because it needs .git in order to make a commit. What keeps it in scope is the Commit Subfolder setting below: every `git add` is scoped to that folder, so the sidecar can only ever commit the same folder the API can write to. Anything else in the working tree is left alone.
Set Commit Subfolder to the SAME folder that claude-files exposes. The container refuses to start if it is empty, ".", absolute, or contains "..", since any of those would silently widen it to the whole repository.
It polls rather than using inotify on purpose: unRAID's /mnt/user is a FUSE layer and inotify through it silently drops events, which would mean files that never get committed and nothing to tell you.
Container.Requires: Pairs with the claude-files container pointed at the same folder.

Config.Name: Repository Root
Config.Description: HOST PATH OF THE REPOSITORY ROOT (the folder containing .git), e.g. /mnt/user/appdata/repos/myrepo. This is wider than what claude-files mounts, because committing requires .git. Scope is enforced by Commit Subfolder below.

Config.Name: Commit Subfolder
Config.Description: Folder to commit, RELATIVE to the repository root. Must match the folder claude-files exposes. Every git add is scoped to this path. The container refuses to start if this is empty, '.', absolute, or contains '..'.

Config.Name: Poll Interval (seconds)
Config.Description: Seconds between checks for new files.

Config.Name: Quiet Period (seconds)
Config.Description: Skip the commit if any file changed this recently, so a burst of uploads becomes one commit instead of catching a half-finished batch. 0 disables.

Config.Name: Git Branch
Config.Description: Branch to commit and push. Must be the branch currently checked out in the repo; the container refuses to start otherwise.

Config.Name: SSH Deploy Key
Config.Description: Host path to a private deploy key with write access to this one repository. Mounted read-only and re-staged to tmpfs at 0600 inside the container. Leave blank if using a token instead.

Config.Name: SSH Key Path
Config.Description: Where the deploy key is mounted inside the container. Leave as-is unless you changed the path above. Clear this if you are using a token.

Config.Name: SSH known_hosts
Config.Description: Host path to a known_hosts file pinning your git host's key. Generate with: ssh-keyscan github.com > known_hosts. Strongly recommended -- without it the sidecar trusts the host key on first use.

Config.Name: SSH known_hosts Path
Config.Description: Where known_hosts is mounted inside the container. Clear this to allow trust-on-first-use instead.

Config.Name: Git Token
Config.Description: Personal access token, as an alternative to an SSH deploy key. Held in tmpfs and never written to disk. Leave blank when using a key.

Config.Name: Max Changed Files
Config.Description: Runaway guard. If more than this many files changed in one poll, refuse to commit and log loudly rather than pushing what might be a mass deletion. 0 disables.

Config.Name: Push
Config.Description: Set to false to commit locally without pushing to the remote.

Config.Name: Dry Run
Config.Description: Log what would be committed and change nothing. Useful for a cycle or two when first setting this up.

Config.Name: Commit Message Prefix
Config.Description: Prefix for generated commit messages. The file count is appended, and the changed paths go in the commit body.
